svg.title: Plug preset
svg.desc: Two top views of the one-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults, a 25 mm wide plug in teal. Right: plug preset set to Flat 2-prong lamp plug - NEMA 1-15. Marked in red: 1, the zip-tie holes: the four small holes beside the pocket. 2, the finger holes: the two large holes in the lower half. 3, the zip-tie holes, the wing openings, the wall notch and the body edge.
